trades.note: Voltage and cell series count are one decision; the engine-out battery voltage limit binds
trades.precedent: X-57 hit interference between its inverters and onboard systems and redesigned its battery for overheating; integration problems and component shortages ended the programme before first flight.
sources: NASA: X-57 project creates paths toward electric aviation

trades.label: Tilt mechanism: spindle station, bearings and fitting concept
trades.note: Sets whirl flutter, jump take-off root strain and nacelle CG against the elastic axis
trades.precedent: V-22 tilts the whole nacelle: engine, gearbox and rotor. V-280 keeps the engines fixed and tilts only the proprotor gearbox; Bell cites maintenance (engine, shaft and gearbox removable independently) and says the V-280 weighs less than a V-22. Halo already keeps the turbines in the fuselage and tilts only motors, gearbox and rotor, the V-280 logic carried further.
sources: The War Zone: V-280 against V-22, with Bell's head of tiltrotor systems

trades.label: Failure architecture: interconnect shaft or electrical cross-strapping
trades.note: Needs asymmetric failure cases with roll trim
trades.precedent: XV-15 and V-22 both carry a cross-shaft so one engine drives both rotors; V-280 kept it. No tiltrotor that has flown has replaced the shaft with electrical cross-strapping, so Halo's choice carries certification risk as well as mass.
sources: The War Zone: V-280 against V-22, with Bell's head of tiltrotor systems

trades.label: Weight margin policy: confidence level and management reserve
trades.note: 99 % today; sets the NTE take-off weight
trades.precedent: V-22: 1,520 kg empty-weight overrun in full-scale development; the next phase gave each integrated product team a weight allocation to hold or trade, the discipline this ledger encodes.
sources: Flight International, 'Tilting in favour' (2000), as reported

trades.label: Design loads: ultimate and jump take-off load factors (4.5, 2.0)
Whirl-flutter margin: frequency placement or flutter-speed margin
trades.note: Frequency placement is a proxy for the flutter boundary
trades.precedent: XV-15 and V-22 use 23 % thick wings to keep whirl flutter beyond dive speed, at a drag and speed cost; a 15 % NASA design lost stiffness, and tailoring recovered stability at about 18 %. Halo's NACA 2423 follows the same precedent.
sources: Acree, Peyran and Johnson, NASA/TP-2004-212262 (thin-wing whirl flutter), as reported

trades.label: Certification basis and design assurance levels
trades.note: Drives redundancy and avionics weight
trades.precedent: AW609: applied in 2012, certified as a special-class powered-lift on a basis drawn from Parts 23, 25 and 29 (17,500 lb maximum weight); the criteria took effect on 2 December 2024. A tiltrotor's certification basis is itself a long-lead risk.

trades.label: Primary structure manufacturing and joining: integrated composite, bonded or fastened, machined metal
trades.note: Part and fastener count is weight

trades.label: HV installation standard: insulation, connectors, shielding and segregation
trades.note: Partial discharge at altitude and EMI

trades.label: Integration rig before first flight: HV powertrain and conversion on an iron bird
trades.note: Buys schedule certainty at the cost of a rig
trades.precedent: X-57's integration problems (interference between inverters and onboard systems, a battery redesign) and late component shortages ended the programme before first flight.
sources: NASA: X-57 project creates paths toward electric aviation

trades.label: Envelope expansion: build-up flight test or model-based clearance of the conversion corridor
trades.note: The computed corridor is edgewise-limited above 45 deg

trades.label: Means of compliance: test or analysis credit for whirl flutter and failure cases
trades.precedent: AW609 needed new criteria for the transition between modes; its special-class basis took effect in December 2024, twelve years after application.

trades.label: Maintenance concept: on-condition or scheduled for tilt mechanism, gearboxes and packs
trades.note: Access and removal paths are set in design
trades.precedent: V-280 fixed its engines partly so that engine, drive shaft and gearbox can be removed independently, which Bell says cuts maintenance time.
sources: The War Zone: V-280 against V-22, with Bell's head of tiltrotor systems

trades.label: Battery replacement policy: pack life against end-of-life sizing
In-service growth reserve: weight and power held back for modifications
trades.note: Fixed engines leave no power growth path
